scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run db:push && uv sync --project worker
scripts.start: npm --prefix web run build && concurrently -n web,worker -c blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix web run start" "uv run --directory worker python -m clipforge_worker"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,worker -c blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "npm --prefix web run dev" "uv run --directory worker python -m clipforge_worker"
scripts.test: npm --prefix web test && uv run --directory worker pytest -q
